title: Distributed Eval Farm Coordinator
tagline: Partition cases, lease shards and aggregate bounded concurrent workers.
summary: Build a persistent same-host evaluation coordinator that partitions recorded predictions, leases shards to real worker processes, fences stale completions and retains dataset-bound receipts.
usefulFor: Resume interrupted batch evaluations with exact dataset identity
Inspect shard ownership, process receipts and stale-worker rejection
youWillBuild: Build a persistent same-host evaluation coordinator that partitions recorded predictions, leases shards to real worker processes, fences stale completions and retains dataset-bound receipts.
skills: Run a bounded local worker pool
prerequisites: Go 1.22 or later on Linux or macOS
Python 3.10 or later for the grader
Go structs, pointers, errors and JSON files

stages.title: Partition stable case identities
stages.summary: Assign each nonempty unique case ID to one of a positive number of shards using FNV-1a.

stages.title: Fence each shard lease
stages.summary: A coordinator owns a lease record.

stages.title: Accept idempotent completion receipts
stages.summary: A completion carries shard owner, lease version and a nonempty result.

stages.title: Run a bounded local worker pool
stages.summary: Compose the bounded pool with persistent leases and actual worker processes; retain scored case coverage and reject stale receipts.
